scope: Host behavior the 0.5.0 packaging relies on. Throwaway homes, local copies, fictional inputs. No City site or account touched.

claude_plugin_root.method: Installed the plugin from a local-path marketplace into a throwaway HOME, invoked /laguna-beach:laguna-permit-preparer in print mode from an empty task directory, ran a Bash echo of $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and a Python os.environ read, and asked the model to copy the substituted text from the skill body.
claude_plugin_root.skill_body_substitution: substituted with the absolute plugin path
claude_plugin_root.documented_at: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference#environment-variables (variables are not present in Bash tool commands; skill content is substituted inline)
claude_plugin_root.conclusion: Never rely on a $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT shell variable. Put ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in skill text and fall back to the SKILL.md location on other hosts.

claude_absolute_paths_activation.method: Same throwaway install; asked the preparer skill (host check only) to confirm the root and validate permit-work/state/project-facts.json from the task directory.
commands_run: python3 "<plugin-root>/scripts/validate-json.py" --schema "<plugin-root>/schemas/project-facts.schema.json" permit-work/state/project-facts.json  -> exit 1 (expected: the fixture was deliberately incomplete)
claude_absolute_paths_activation.conclusion: The wrapper's root and absolute-path instructions work from the user's task directory.

connector_unauthenticated.claude_code: plugin:laguna-beach:crossbeam listed as 'Needs authentication'; print-mode session still completed
connector_unauthenticated.codex_cli_0.162.0: crossbeam listed, enabled, 'Not logged in'; `codex mcp login crossbeam` performs OAuth
connector_unauthenticated.gemini_cli_0.63.0: crossbeam (from laguna-beach) listed as Disconnected until `/mcp auth crossbeam`
connector_unauthenticated.server_discovery: POST /mcp without a token returns 401 with resource_metadata; /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server advertises dynamic client registration and S256 PKCE

marketplace_pinning.method: Local git repository with two commits; git-subdir entry pointing at the older commit; installed with each host into a throwaway home.

codex_auth_policy: Codex reports authPolicy ON_INSTALL for entries in the Claude-format marketplace. The CLI install did not prompt. The ChatGPT desktop app's behavior with ON_INSTALL was not tested.
